briefing.headline: OpenAI Orion and Google Gemini 3 push frontier capabilities amid escalating safety concerns

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race intensifies with multiple frontier labs releasing advanced models in August 2026. Funding remains robust while regulatory scrutiny grows over deployment risks. Prompt injection attacks continue to dominate real-world incidents.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed Orion-1 with multimodal reasoning gains. Anthropic released Claude 4 Opus and Meta open-sourced Llama 4 405B. DeepSeek-V3 achieved top benchmark scores at lower inference cost.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and IoT environments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA announced Blackwell Ultra shipments ramping to 500k units quarterly. Microsoft and Google expanded data center capacity in Texas and Arizona with new 100MW clusters.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first publicly deployed 10-trillion-parameter model trigger mandatory international safety audits by Q4 2026?
